sentence: This project tests a drug that blocks a kinase protein, given with chemotherapy, in patients with pancreatic cancer that has spread.
This project studies how a complex of proteins that glycosylate another protein helps cause childhood low-grade glioma.
This project creates and studies Xenopus mutants with changes in key genes related to human diseases.
This project studies in mice how macrophages and a molecule in tumor cells help cancer spread to lymph nodes.
This project studies how neuroinflammation contributes to global cerebral ischemia after cardiac arrest and tests inhibitors that may reduce the neurological deficits.
This project studies how mRNA carried in extracellular vesicles changes macrophages to help tumors grow and switches off T-cell activity.
This project studies how emergency myelopoiesis pathways help acute myeloid leukemia develop and progress.
This project coordinates a network of researchers who study immunotherapy in dogs with cancer to inform human clinical trial design.
This project studies how exposure to airborne hazardous chemicals during adolescence alters brain development through oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction.
This project provides research resources to support work on rising alcohol-related mortality among women.
This project supports molecular biology research that looks at what its findings mean for human health.
This project studies the cellular and molecular steps by which androgen guides the development of the male reproductive tract.
This project studies how the chemistry of imaging probes shapes their behavior in the body to build imaging tools that need no radiation.
This project studies why brain networks become overly or weakly connected in tau mouse models, using imaging and spatial proteomics.
This project uses optical coherence tomography to look for a marker of glial dysfunction in people and mice with Alzheimer's disease.
This project supports clinical and translational research aimed at meeting the health needs of society.
This project measures how much deep brain stimulation devices and cardiac implants heat up during MRI in low-field scanners.
This project uses artificial intelligence and metabolomics to build a metabolic clock that tells healthy aging apart from Alzheimer's disease.
This project builds software that helps teams analyze genomes to diagnose critically ill newborns and people in undiagnosed disease clinics.
This project studies which patient, surgical and mechanical factors change how the cervical spine wears down after fusion surgery.
